newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint closes unchanged against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint closes unchanged against dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed Wednesday's lacklustre trading unchanged against the dollar from midday levels, dealers said.
"Almost nothing happened in the afternoon," said Agnes Nagy of Altalanos Ertekforgalmi Bank. "Many banks have given up opening speculative positions ahead the year-end holidays."
The forint finished at 159.65/70, unchanged from midday.

Dealers said the forint lazily followed dollar/mark in the afternoon and traded some 40 fillers below the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid), compared with a differential of some 50 fillers at midday.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention band against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
Dollar futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) eased or remained steady, while mark maturities closed firmer or flat. The Ecu finished mixed.
Foreign currency futures trade in one single session, in the morning, on the BCE. On the interbank foreign currency market, the forint firmed against the dollar in the morning.
